why: No major reviewer or authority tests power stations against a pellet stove. The results are concept guides (portableenergylab, StoveAtlas, Angi), an Anker brand blog, Comfortbilt support pages that only confirm compatibility, a lifestyle post naming one EcoFlow, a UPS page, an electrician's wiring blog, and two unreadable entries. Only BuyerSheet answers with spec-based runtime tracking, and it is untested. A focused page with a 12-hour sizing calculation, pure-sine and switchover checks, named picks and current prices would stand out.
